name: Renn’s secondhand gear

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Renn prepares the investigator to search the wreck with repaired gear.
description: Renn McGill confirms that the Defias have divers among the wreckage and accepts the orders as a reason to search first. The scattered ship remains stretch from the eastern coast of the island toward Alcaz, while the naga-held waters are dangerous. Before the diver can enter the search, damaged diving gear and tools must be recovered and repaired. The work turns the hidden cargo into a physical trail under the waterline.
